answers.core: An add-on could solve the problem only if it was a direct copy of the TileMap system with the upgrades built in. TileMap might as well be an add-on itself if that is a better way to manage it.
answers.workaround: The enhancement of TileMap can only be done to the node itself. TileMap works too directly with the rendering server to use scripting to solve the issue.

title: Add TileMap edge culling for quick tile composites on the fly
